title: SREV-081 PipeServer AppContainer port DACL contract

descriptor.description: Explicit SDDL security descriptor for the service port

principal.description: Normal and AppContainer SID halves of the access decision

fallback.description: Legacy explicit DACL for OS builds that do not recognize AC

contracts: the service side owns the named port security descriptor
the client side must not bypass AppContainer token semantics to connect
normal clients keep the legacy any-process connect shape through WD
AppContainer clients need an explicit AC ACE on systems that understand AC
older systems that do not know AC fall back to an explicit WD DACL
the port must not be published with a NULL DACL
